_comment: Defense Watch — RANKINGS SECTION dataset. Primes and subcontractors ranked SEPARATELY. Company names, categories, ownership, and public financials are REAL and current as of the noted dates. The four pillar scores and the resulting arsenal_score are EDITORIAL ESTIMATES produced by applying the Arsenal methodology by judgment — they are NOT sourced figures and must be reviewed before publication. Adversary-exposure claims about named companies (esp. Divergent) must be verified against primary cap-table / CFIUS sources before any public use.

_schema.arsenal_score: 0-100 composite = weighted sum of four normalized pillars (see scoring_model.json)
_schema.pillar_scores: each 0-100. adversary_exposure is INVERSE: HIGH = LESS China/adversary exposure (good), LOW = MORE exposure (bad)
_schema.pillar_weights_used: prime: surge .30 / investment .20 / america .25 / adversary .25 ; sub: surge .35 / investment .25 / america .20 / adversary .20
_schema.data_confidence: high = public financials verified; medium = private/estimated scale; low = fast-moving startup or unverified exposure

pillar_rationale.surge_capacity: Deep programs and Missiles & Fire Control expansion, but legacy line lead-times cap ramp speed.
pillar_rationale.investment_quality: Blue-chip institutional base, heavy DoD-aligned capital, strong balance sheet.
pillar_rationale.america_score: Overwhelmingly US workforce, footprint, and supply base; large domestic tax presence.
pillar_rationale.adversary_exposure: Cleared prime with tight ITAR controls; residual sub-tier China dependency in electronics/materials.

subcontractors.name: Rocketdyne (ex-Aerojet)

pillar_rationale.surge_capacity: Legacy propulsion chokepoint; capacity expansion underway but slow.

subcontractors._note: Formerly Aerojet Rocketdyne. L3Harris acquired Aerojet in 2023 and split it in early 2026: space-propulsion assets ('Rocketdyne') sold to AE Industrial Partners; missile-motor assets retained by L3Harris as 'Missile Solutions'. This entry reflects the space-propulsion successor.

subcontractors.name: Divergent Technologies

subcontractors._note: Included deliberately as the flagship illustration of the Adversary Exposure pillar: a company with elite advanced-manufacturing capability (high Surge) ranked LOW because of foreign/adversary-linked capital. The China-exposure characterization is based on publicly reported funding history and is an EDITORIAL ESTIMATE that must be verified against primary sources (cap table, CFIUS filings) before any public-facing use. Do not present the adversary linkage as established fact without that verification.
